policy.rationale: The fewest file-sharing and remote-desktop links to cut between the functional networks (core servers, imaging and PACS, bedside monitoring, clinical workstations, business) so an attack from any workstation stays in its own segment. Feeds between networks (HL7, vendor ports) start closed and reopen only where clinical engineering names them; DICOM to PACS, charts over HTTPS and common time stay open. Average over 16 attack starts: 2.6 devices infected (vs 10.1 without segmentation).
policy.tradeoff: Chosen by an optimizer over every starting point, not just this one.
